gloss: to refuse; to reject; to resist

definitions.explanation: To firmly say no to a request or offer.
To not accept or not allow something.
To stand against or prevent something from happening.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{申|もう}し{出|で}を{拒|こば}んだ。
{入国|にゅうこく}を{拒|こば}まれた。
examples.english: I was denied entry into the country.

examples.japanese: {協力|きょうりょく}を{拒|こば}む{理由|りゆう}はない。
examples.english: There's no reason to refuse cooperation.

notes:
{拒|こば}む is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). There is no common intransitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{拒|こば}んでいる indicates a continuing state of refusal or rejection.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {申|もう}し{出|で}を{拒|こば}む - to refuse an offer
- {入場|にゅうじょう}/{入国|にゅうこく}を{拒|こば}む - to deny entry
- {協力|きょうりょく}を{拒|こば}む - to refuse cooperation
- {拒|こば}み{続|つづ}ける - to keep refusing

{拒|こば}む VS {断|ことわ}る:
- {拒|こば}む is more formal and literary, implying firm rejection
- {断|ことわ}る is more common in everyday speech and can be polite refusal
- {拒|こば}む often implies resistance or stubborn refusal

RELATED WORDS:
- {拒否|きょひ} - refusal, rejection (noun)
- {拒絶|きょぜつ} - rejection (stronger)
